# meets

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:meets`](gmeow-meets.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/meets>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)

Allen MEETS: this event ends exactly when the related event begins (no gap, no overlap). NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:metBy`](gmeow-metBy.md). (= [time:intervalMeets](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalMeets); TimeML IBEFORE / immediately-before; TEO meets.)
